_comment: The vitest files that dominate suite wall time, split out so CI can run them
on their own runner in parallel with everything else instead of queueing them
behind (and in front of) the fast files.
Measured on the ubuntu-latest 4-vCPU runner (workflow run 31054750716):
these four files account for 1811 s of the 1895 s of total vitest file time.
The other 78 files together are ~84 s.
Every entry is a REAL finite-element cost, not a sleep or a retry: full
TetGen meshes at 30k-75k elements plus CG solves. Do not add a file here to
make CI look faster -- the list exists so the scheduler can overlap the
expensive work, and a file in the wrong shard just moves the cost around.
Keep this list in sync with reality: if a file here drops below ~30 s, move
it back to the light shard so the heavy job stays a true critical path.
